verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a SaaS cap-table platform, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question. The evidence never mentions a public API or an OpenAPI/equivalent spec, and the probe found 404s at every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path. The read-only MCP server and the help-centre llms.txt are adjacent features, not a downloadable machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
